text:
maria: Heads-up — we're consolidating the SLO boundary from 95% to 97% for the regional routing tier this Thursday night and running a regional drain + failover simulation in us-west-2 during the same window. Window: Thu 23:00-00:30 PT. Expected visible impact: short p99 latency blips (~5-15% for ~5-12m) while drains finish. Please read runbook and ack.

kevin: acked. Which routes are in scope?

maria: only `api-generation-v2` and `chat-stream` for the initial run. We'll exclude embeddings and admin traffic.

aj: noted. What's the rollback plan if we see error spikes?

maria: rollback = cancel drains -> reassign traffic to secondary edge pool; automatic fallback policy will kick in after 60s if request error rate > 3%. Manual steps in runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/slo-boundary-shift-2026 (TL;DR: `trafficctl route set --pool secondary --route api-generation-v2`)

jess: I'll pre-warm KV caches for the secondary pool 30m before start. Command for cache prefill: `./tools/prefill_kv.sh --prefix api-gen --targets secondary`

sre-bot: Reminder: oncall will get an automated page if p50 latency > 300ms AND p99 error rate > 2% for 2 consecutive minutes during the window.

oncall-runner: oncall here (night shift). I'll be standing by 22:45 PT. Can you post the exact canary schedule?

maria: Canary plan: 23:05 small canary (5%) -> 23:15 ramp to 25% -> 23:30 full drain. If canary fails at any step, we stop and rollback.

kevin: metrics to watch: p99 latency (route-level), error-rate, backend queue length, and KV miss-rate. Dashboard links: https://dash.redwood/slo/regional-routing and https://dash.redwood/alerts/fallbacks

aj: one ask — please ensure SLO change is only metadata change until Canary completes. We don't want consumer-side thresholds to flip mid-run.

maria: good call — we'll flip the SLO boundary in the control plane only after successful full drain verification at 23:50. Metadata flag will be `slo.apply_post_canary=false` during canary.

jess: posting quick checklist in thread: 1) prefill KV (22:30) 2) healthcheck sweep (22:45) 3) canary 5% (23:05) 4) canary 25% (23:15) 5) full drain (23:30) 6) apply SLO metadata (23:50) 7) post-run verification (00:20).

oncall-runner: I'll run the healthcheck script and confirm. `./ops/healthcheck.sh --routes api-generation-v2,chat-stream`

sre-bot: Deploy-bot: control-plane patch scheduled at 23:00 PT with zero-downtime migration note.

maria: Thanks everyone. If you see anything unexpected ping @maria and @oncall-runner immediately. :pray:
